info.title: CF Meet public API — communications
info.description: Sections 4–7 personal communications identity and contact foundation. Existing Account authentication is authoritative. No phone OTP or phone-number discovery in this milestone. Internal policy, principal, lifecycle and operator APIs are private and excluded.
